page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. The catchword and gathering signature are at the foot. A brace in the right margin beside the Eleutherius paragraph is a printer's mark, not text. Three numbered headings (10, 11, 12) each open a short paragraph.

main_text.p: ficisse perhibetur: martyrij gloriam anno Domini 159. in sui sanguinis effusione tum demum adeptus.
main_text.head: 10. ANICETVS Syrus.

p.i: Anicetus Syrus, Romanæ Ecclesiæ in verbi minis-terio sacro, laboriose præfuit: & anno nati Ser-vatoris 169. in magna Christianæ fidei constantia, pro Dei veritate sanguinem postremò fudit.

main_text.head: 11. SOTHER Campanus.

p.i: Sother Campanus, in armis spiritualibus Christo fideliter militauit, sub Antonino Commodo: hoc unum agens præcipuè, ut animas per baptismum Christo dicatas, doctrina & exemplo illi suo spon[?]so salvandas adduceret. Mortemq; sui corporis anno Domini 177. pro Christi ipsius testimonio pertulit.

main_text.head: 12. ELEVTHERIVS Græcus.

p.i: Eleutherius Græcus, ut bonus paterfamilias, de thesauro suo nova cum veteribus proferens, effecit, ut confirmatis & consolidatis Britannis in suscepta prius ab Apostolis doctrina, totum illud regnum in eius fidei verba iuraret. Quibus temporibus, tyrannorum persecutio paulisper conquievit: multiq; scriptores pii, contra pravorum dogmatum disseminatores fortiter dimicarunt: ipso etiam Eleutherio adversus Tatianum, nullum usua-lis victus reiiciendum esse genus decernente. page.notes: The "suo spon[?]so" line break is unclear: the scan shows "fpon" at the line end and "fo" at the start of the next line with no visible hyphen. The word is marked as doubtful. The hyphen in "usua-lis" and "minis-terio" is printed; "Ser-vatoris" is printed as "Ser-" with "uatoris" on the next line. The j in "reijciendum" is read as an i (reiiciendum). Words divided at line ends without a printed hyphen ("conquievit", "etiam") are written whole.
